mapper.select: SELECT t.*, d.name AS dept_name, u.email AS author_email, s.email AS assignee_name FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = t.department_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.author_id LEFT JOIN users s ON s.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.id = #{ticketId}

SELECT t.*, d.name AS dept_name, u.email AS author_email, s.email AS assignee_name FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = t.department_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.author_id LEFT JOIN users s ON s.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.author_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.last_activity_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.*, d.name AS dept_name, u.email AS author_email, s.email AS assignee_name FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = t.department_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.author_id LEFT JOIN users s ON s.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.assignee_id = #{staffId} ORDER BY t.last_activity_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.*, d.name AS dept_name, u.email AS author_email, s.email AS assignee_name FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = t.department_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.author_id LEFT JOIN users s ON s.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.department_id = #{deptId} AND t.assignee_id IS NULL AND t.closed = 0 ORDER BY t.unread_staff DESC, t.created_at LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.*, d.name AS dept_name, u.email AS author_email, s.email AS assignee_name FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = t.department_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.author_id LEFT JOIN users s ON s.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.department_id = #{deptId} AND t.title LIKE '%' || #{titleKeyword} || '%' ORDER BY t.last_activity_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tickets (ticket_code, title, content, status, priority, department_id, author_id, unread_staff, closed, edited_title, created_at, updated_at, last_activity_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{ticket.title}, #{ticket.content}, 'OPEN', #{ticket.priority}, #{ticket.departmentId}, #{ticket.authorId}, 1, 0, 0, datetime('now'), datetime('now'), datetime('now'))
mapper.update: UPDATE tickets SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, priority = #{priority}, department_id = #{departmentId}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, unread_staff = #{unreadStaff}, closed = #{closed}, edited_title = #{editedTitle}, updated_at = datetime('now'), last_activity_at = #{lastActivityAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tickets SET updated_at = datetime('now'), last_activity_at = #{lastActivityAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tickets SET updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id IN #{t.id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM tags WHERE name = #{name}
mapper.update: UPDATE tickets SET unread_staff = 0 WHERE id = #{ticketId}
UPDATE tickets SET assignee_id = #{staffId}, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{ticketId}
UPDATE tickets SET assignee_id = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{ticketId}
UPDATE tickets SET closed = 1, status = 'CLOSED', updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{ticketId}
UPDATE tickets SET closed = 0, status = 'REOPENED', assignee_id = NULL, unread_staff = 1, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{ticketId}
UPDATE tickets SET department_id = #{newDeptId}, assignee_id = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{ticketId}
UPDATE tickets SET assignee_id = NULL WHERE author_id = #{authorId}
UPDATE tickets SET closed = 1, status = 'CLOSED', updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE author_id = #{authorId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tags (name, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, datetime('now'))
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO ticket_tags (ticket_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{tagId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ticket_tags WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND tag_id = #{tagId}
